english.note: Use 入時 for a generally up-to-date, in-fashion appearance rather than specifically a cool or youth-oriented style.

examples.english: After getting a new hairstyle, Mum looks really fashionable.
examples.traditional: 阿媽剪完個新髮型，成個人都好入時。
